title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Printing and Distributing the Guiding Opinions on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Mechanism for Prevention and Control of Integrity Risks in People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Risk Prevention and Control Mechanism for Judicial Integrity in People's Courts

Fa [2012] No. 122

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Guiding Opinions on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Risk Prevention and Control Mechanism for Judicial Integrity in People's Courts of the Supreme People's Court are hereby issued to you. Please implement them earnestly in light of the actual work.

May 3, 2012

Guiding Opinions on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Risk Prevention and Control Mechanism for Judicial Integrity in People's Courts

To comprehensively promote the construction of a risk prevention and control mechanism for judicial integrity in people's courts, further standardize and deepen the work of risk prevention and control for judicial integrity in people's courts, and in accordance with the Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Risk Prevention and Control for Clean Government of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and in light of the actual work of people's courts, the following guiding opinions are hereby put forward.

I. Guiding Ideology, Working Principles, and Overall Objectives

1. Guiding ideology. We shall take Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents" as guidance, thoroughly implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, follow the requirements of "while resolutely punishing corruption, pay more attention to addressing root causes, prevention, and institutional building", take the restriction and supervision of the exercise of judicial power as the core, base on post risk prevention and control, focus on strengthening institutional building, and rely on modern information technology, to comprehensively construct a risk prevention and control mechanism for judicial integrity that features clear powers and responsibilities, standardized processes, clear risks, effective monitoring, effective institutions, timely warnings, and proper disposal, and continuously improve the scientific, institutionalized, and standardized level of anti-corruption and integrity building in people's courts.

2. Working principles. We shall adhere to centering on the central task, closely integrating risk prevention and control for judicial integrity with the judicial case-handling work of people's courts, incorporating risk prevention and control for judicial integrity into the business work and management processes of each department, to achieve mutual promotion and coordinated development of risk prevention and control for judicial integrity with the trial business, team building, and administrative management of people's courts; we shall adhere to court characteristics, making risk prevention and control for judicial integrity conform to the laws of justice and the actual situation of courts, with strong pertinence and operability; we shall adhere to systematic governance, using systematic thinking, comprehensive concepts, and scientific methods to advance the work, expanding the areas of work to prevent and punish corruption from the source; we shall adhere to reform and innovation, respecting the pioneering spirit of grassroots courts and the vast number of court personnel, bravely practicing, and exploring new ideas, new methods, and new approaches for punishing and preventing corruption; we shall adhere to adapting measures to local conditions, reasonably determining work objectives, tasks, methods, and steps according to the characteristics of different regions, different departments, and different posts, strengthening classified guidance, implementing classified management, and advancing the work step by step, actively and steadily.

3. Work objectives. We shall focus on work posts and links where corruption is prone to occur frequently, comprehensively construct a risk prevention and control mechanism for judicial integrity covering all levels of people's courts and all internal departments and institutions, and on the basis of full practice, ensure that the prevention and control mechanism is reasonably structured and operates smoothly, that relevant supporting institutions are complete and effectively implemented, and that the effectiveness of corruption prevention is evident and continuously improving.

II. Work Steps

4. Clarify the scope of powers. In accordance with the requirements of statutory powers and consistency of powers and responsibilities, we shall sort out various types of powers lawfully enjoyed by people's courts item by item, compile a catalogue of powers, clarify the name, main content, exercising subject, and legal basis of the powers of each department and post, and on this basis, for each item of power, draw a flow chart for the exercise of power, optimize the operation flow, and clarify the subject of handling, conditions, procedures, time limits, and supervision methods, etc., to achieve openness in the exercise of power, clarity in post responsibilities, and standardization of work processes.

5. Investigate integrity risks. Through self-examination, public evaluation, expert suggestions, leadership prompts, case analysis, organizational review, and other means, we shall focus on investigating integrity risks existing in the exercise of power, institutional mechanisms, external environment, and the ideology and ethics of court personnel in each department and post. In terms of the exercise of power, we shall focus on investigating the risk of power abuse that may be caused by excessive concentration of power, non-standard operation procedures, and excessive discretion; in terms of institutional mechanisms, we shall focus on investigating the risk of loss of control of power that may be caused by incomplete rules and regulations and imperfect supervision and restriction mechanisms; in terms of external environment, we shall focus on investigating the risk of judicial injustice that may be caused by interest temptation, personal relationship interference, and other abnormal factors; in terms of the ideology and ethics of court personnel, we shall focus on investigating the risk of misconduct that may be induced by unstable ideals and beliefs, non-solid work style, and weak professional ethics.

6. Assess risk levels. According to the importance of the power, the size of discretion, the probability of corruption and its degree of harm, and other factors, risk levels shall be assessed according to the three levels of "high", "medium", and "low", and graded management, graded responsibility, and responsibility assigned to individuals shall be implemented for different levels of integrity risks.

7. Formulate prevention and control measures. In accordance with laws and regulations, terms of reference, work standards, and integrity requirements, specific, effective, and feasible prevention and control measures shall be formulated for the identified integrity risks, and a schematic diagram of integrity risk prevention and control work shall be drawn. For risks in the exercise of power, procedures for the exercise of power shall be established and improved, effective methods of decentralization and control of power shall be explored, and the exercise of power shall be standardized; for risks in institutional mechanisms, in accordance with the requirements of establishing and improving the system for punishing and preventing corruption, the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms shall be further deepened, the anti-corruption and integrity system shall be continuously improved, and the implementation of existing institutions shall be effectively grasped; for risks in the external environment, through the further promotion of judicial openness, the comprehensive strengthening of internal and external supervision, efforts shall be made to build an "isolation wall" to resist external interference; for risks in the ideology and ethics of court personnel, through the regular conduct of education on Party spirit, Party discipline, professional ethics, and professional discipline, the risk prevention awareness of the vast number of court personnel shall be enhanced, and the consciousness of honest justice and honest governance shall be improved.

8. Implement warning and disposal. For work posts and links where corruption is prone to occur frequently, through judicial inspection, trial supervision, case evaluation, petition reception, public opinion analysis, and other work, integrity risk information shall be comprehensively collected, risk warnings shall be issued for emerging and trending issues that may trigger corruption, and timely disposal shall be carried out through comprehensive use of risk reminders, admonishing interviews, orders to correct errors, and other means.

9. Adhere to dynamic management. In conjunction with social development, legal adjustments, functional changes, and the new requirements of the people for the anti-corruption and integrity building of people's courts, the content, levels, and prevention and control measures of integrity risks shall be promptly evaluated and adjusted, the working mechanism for integrity risk prevention and control shall be continuously improved, and the practical effectiveness of integrity risk prevention and control shall be continuously enhanced.

III. Work Requirements

10. Strengthen organizational leadership. People's courts at all levels shall combine the construction of the integrity risk prevention and control mechanism with strengthening the construction of Party organizations in the organs and implementing the responsibility system for the construction of Party conduct and integrity. The principal heads of Party groups and internal departments of people's courts at all levels shall be primarily responsible for the integrity risk prevention and control work of their units and departments, taking the lead in doing a good job of integrity risk prevention and control for themselves and within their jurisdiction. The discipline inspection and supervision departments and integrity supervisors of people's courts at all levels shall proactively undertake the tasks of organization, coordination, supervision, and inspection, and actively promote the implementation of integrity risk prevention and control work.

11. Ensure full participation. People's courts at all levels shall mobilize all court personnel to participate extensively in the construction of the integrity risk prevention and control mechanism, ensuring that no corner is left untouched. At the same time, the process of finding integrity risks and formulating prevention and control measures shall be made a process of self-education, self-warning, and strengthening self-discipline for each department and each court personnel, prompting the vast number of court personnel to firmly establish the core values of "loyalty, serving the people, justice, and integrity" for political and legal personnel, and further enhance their ability to resist interference, resist corruption, and administer justice impartially.

12. Highlight prevention and control priorities. On the basis of comprehensive prevention and control of integrity risks, people's courts at all levels shall strengthen the integrity risk prevention and control work for court leading cadres, trial and execution posts, and posts managing personnel, finance, and materials. In criminal trial activities, risk prevention and control shall be strengthened for links such as lighter punishment, mitigated punishment, exemption from punishment, remand for retrial, and retrial and alteration of judgment; in civil, commercial, and administrative trial activities, risk prevention and control shall be strengthened for links such as case filing review, property preservation, mediation and reconciliation, remand for retrial, order for retrial, and higher-level court trial; in execution activities, risk prevention and control shall be strengthened for links such as entrusted evaluation, auction, sale, and division of execution property; in personnel and administrative management activities, risk prevention and control shall be strengthened for links such as cadre appointment, asset management, financial reimbursement, material procurement, and project construction.

13. Improve institutional mechanisms. People's courts at all levels shall, for the "joints" of power operation, the "weak points" of internal management, and the "risk points" prone to problems, comprehensively establish a risk prevention and control institutional system of prevention before the event, monitoring during the event, and punishment after the event, effectively ensuring the management of power by institutions, handling matters according to institutions, and managing personnel by institutions. At the same time, various powers of people's courts shall be scientifically allocated, and a power structure and operation mechanism shall be established and improved where the power of decision, the power of execution, and the power of supervision both restrict and coordinate with each other. The correct exercise of important powers such as the power of trial adjudication, the power of execution of judgments, the power of case handling supervision, the power of cadre appointment, and the power of fund management shall be ensured, and the operation of power behind closed doors and power rent-seeking shall be strictly prevented.

14. Strengthen technological prevention and control. People's courts at all levels shall integrate modern information technology means into the institutional design and management processes of integrity risk prevention and control, establish and improve information management platforms for real-time monitoring of power operation, and gradually achieve online disclosure of power operation, online monitoring of power exercise, online warning of integrity risks, and online acceptance of reports and complaints, continuously improving the scientific and technological level of integrity risk prevention and control work.

15. Ensure practical results. People's courts at all levels shall avoid formalism and ensure that the construction of the integrity risk prevention and control mechanism in their units achieves practical results. The construction of the integrity risk prevention and control mechanism shall be incorporated into the inspection and assessment of the responsibility system for the construction of Party conduct and integrity and the construction of the system for punishing and preventing corruption, and the results of the inspection and assessment shall be used as an important basis for the evaluation and appointment or removal of leading cadres. On an annual cycle, through methods such as self-inspection, random inspection by superiors, and social evaluation, the effectiveness of integrity risk prevention and control work shall be regularly inspected and assessed, ensuring that the construction of the integrity risk prevention and control mechanism is advanced solidly and achieves practical results.
